ar26.name: Report and Accounts 2026 (FY26)
ar26.note: Accounts signed 15-May-2026; filed with the AGM notice before 30-Sep-2026

profile.name: ITC Hotels Ltd
profile.what: India's second-largest listed hotel company by value: 156 operating hotels with 14,372 keys at 30-Jun-2026 (owned ~5,700+ keys, managed/franchised ~8,600+ keys; owned/managed key mix 40/60) under ITC Hotels (luxury; the large ones franchised into Marriott's Luxury Collection), Mementos, Epiq Collection, Storii, Welcomhotel, Fortune and WelcomHeritage; plus ITC Ratnadipa (352 keys) and Sapphire Residences (132 apartments) in Colombo.
profile.origin: Hotels business of ITC Ltd demerged into ITC Hotels Ltd (incorporated 28-Jul-2023) with effect from 1-Jan-2025 (appointed and effective date); ITC kept 40% and ITC's shareholders got 1 ITC Hotels share for every 10 ITC shares (60%). Listed on 29-Jan-2025.
profile.promoter: ITC Ltd 39.85% (83 cr shares); ITC is professionally managed with no promoter of its own; BAT's Tobacco Manufacturers (India) 6.28% at Mar-26 (12.21% at Mar-25)
profile.sharesSrc: AR FY26 note 16: 2,08,29,76,309 equity shares of Re1

portfolio.brandsCols: brand, operating hotels, operating keys, pipeline hotels, pipeline keys (30-Jun-2026)
ownedProjects: Luxury resort; reopening as an ITC Hotels resort by Q3FY27
Managed hotel being bought; integration planned Q2FY27

fy26.exceptionalNote: Labour codes past-service cost Rs54.19 cr; cyclone Ditwah damage in Sri Lanka net of insurance Rs25.98 cr

guidance.managementFees: 2.5x growth in management fees by FY30 over FY25 (q4deck slide 33)
guidance.capex: 10-12% of cumulative revenue on operating capex, renovations, new builds and expansions (q1deck slide 24; 8-10% in q4deck slide 34)
guidance.portfolio: 250 operating hotels and 22,000+ keys by 2031; owned ~7,500 keys, managed ~15,000 (q1deck slides 23-24)
guidance.managedGrowth: Managed portfolio to grow at 12% CAGR to 15,000+ keys (q4deck slide 35)
guidance.noCall: The company publishes a media statement and presentation each quarter; no earnings-call transcript was found in our sources

acquisitions.src: ar26 Board report; q1deck pages 3, 30; Onmanorama 15-May-2026 (https://www.onmanorama.com/news/business/2026/05/15/itc-hotels-to-acquire-luxury-resort-in-kerala-s-kumarakom-for-205-crore.html)

acquisitions.status: 100% stake; enterprise value Rs155 cr debt-free/cash-free; completion expected within Q2FY27

board: Chairperson, non-executive (Chairman & MD of ITC Ltd)
management.src: ar26 p.67 (Board of Directors), consolidated accounts signatures

accounting.screenerReclass: Screener's annual P&L moves ~Rs37-47 cr a year from operating costs to 'Interest' (FY26 interest Rs55 cr vs audited finance costs Rs7.93 cr); quarters are as reported. ITCHOTELS.patch.js restores the audited split (PBT unchanged).
accounting.fy24Column: The FY24 comparative in the FY25 accounts covers ~8 months (28-Jul-2023 to 31-Mar-2024), restated as if the demerger happened from incorporation (ar25 notes); not a full year.
accounting.realEstate: Sapphire Residences revenue is recognised on handover (from Q3FY26); FY26 real-estate development cost Rs138.54 cr sits in operating costs. Lumpy: Rs82 cr (Q3FY26), Rs130 cr (Q4FY26), Rs38 cr (Q1FY27).
accounting.srilankaFx: Colombo assets (ITC Ratnadipa, Sapphire) are translated into rupees: FY26 OCI +Rs134 cr of translation gains; Q1FY27 OCI -Rs210 cr as the Sri Lankan rupee fell.
accounting.exceptional: FY26 exceptional loss Rs80 cr (labour codes Rs54 cr, cyclone Ditwah Rs26 cr); none in FY25.

history: ITC Hotels Ltd incorporated (Kolkata) as the vehicle for ITC's hotels business
Demerger effective (appointed date 1-Jan-2025); ITC keeps 40%, 60% to ITC shareholders (1 for 10)
Shares listed on NSE and BSE
First results as a listed company: FY25 revenue Rs3,560 cr, EBITDA Rs1,211 cr
Sapphire Residences handovers start (Q3); first dividend Rs1; BAT's stake falls from 12.21% to 6.28% and HCL Capital appears with 7.08% (Mar-26)
FY26 results; Kumarakom resort acquisition approved
Q1FY27 results; GHK (Welcomhotel Ahmedabad) acquisition announced
